title: Bindr
description: A Windows desktop app for comic and manga libraries: converts PDFs to CBZ, sorts archives into natural page order, and batch-optimises images with live progress and ETA.

title: Fantomixx
description: A self-hosted comic library backed by PocketBase. Readers browse comics and read CBZ chapters in the browser, while admins manage metadata, upload covers and batch-import chapters.

title: NimCircle
description: A Nimiq Pay Mini App for shared savings goals in NIM. Creators set a target, deadline and goal owner, contributors pay through Nimiq Pay, and the backend verifies each on-chain transaction before it counts toward a Circle's progress.

title: Site Rescue
description: An AI-assisted website rescue tool: a bounded crawl of up to 10 same-origin pages runs 16 evidence-backed checks, then an OpenAI-compatible model prioritises the findings and writes developer tasks. Plans are validated against the scanner's findings, and scans still work if the AI step fails.

title: Cee-Kee-Zy Property Listings
description: A property listing platform for houses, land and vehicles, with a searchable public catalogue, dynamic listing pages and a JWT-protected admin dashboard for creating listings and uploading images.

title: Site Scout
description: A website audit tool that crawls sites with Puppeteer and Lighthouse, scores SEO, performance, accessibility, UX and technical health, and generates proposals and Excel exports.

title: 123 Essentials Website
description: A multi-page marketing website for an IT services company, covering managed IT, cybersecurity, CCTV and access control, web development and networking, with a contact enquiry flow.

title: Developer Portfolio & CMS
description: A static HTML, CSS and JavaScript portfolio with a separate Node.js API and MongoDB database, including a private CMS for drafting and publishing projects, server-rendered project pages and image management.
